out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the ware washing station in the back room was being used hold/store food processing equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Equipment was removed from the sink during the inspection.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Two containers of cleaned cut potatoes were not covered, inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CORRECTED. Both containers were covered during the inpspection.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Gyro meat observed held at room temperature, 81F, next to the grill station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. C ORRECTED. Gyro was discarded during the inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw seafood and poultry observed stored above dressings/sauce, vegetables, in the walk-0in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: gyro beef, and spanakopita pita. These two items were held at room temperatures, with no visible signs of temperature control, after cooking but before serving.gyro=102F, spanakopita pita=73F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED. DURING THYE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: A large knife was found stored between two refrigerated prep tables, on the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Utensils such as knives shall be stored on knives racks or cleaned and sanitized surface, to protect the knife from contamination, after each use. THE BIG GREEK CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): The Continental refrigerated prep tables on the Cook-line were observed to be torn.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. Repair or replace the broken rubber gaskets on the doors of these refrigerators.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: The men’s toilet room door is not provided with an effective self-closing door. The door was observed to be ajar.
violations.corrective_action: Provide an effective self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following hot food storage unit was not properly located in the front coldest part of the unit: Refrigerator located next to the cook-line hand sink washing.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically hot food storage unit, the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the coolest part of the hot food storage unit. Store the thermometer near the opening of the unit.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: unmarked squeeze bottles holding hard-top-identify sauces and liquids were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Employee observed wearing a watch while handling food at the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the cook-line food table.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Scoops were observed laying on foods with the handles in direct contact with the foods at the cold foods serving table.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Train employees on proper handling of in-use utensils, to prevent possible contamination. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. THE BIG GREEK CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room door at the men’s freest room is being kept open and it is not self-closing.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. Install a self-closing device on this door to keep the restroom. Closed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the lid/c lover on the grease trap is not maintained in good repair. Water bubbles from inside the trap, to above the lid when the 3-vat sink is drained.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Seal the grease trap properly for p;roper functioning of this equipment.
